messages:
alia: quick follow-up on StreamFade partials — owners + actions below.
jun: symptom recap: streams hang ~60-120s then a trailing partial chunk is dropped or duplicated on reconnect.
marc: looked at worker traces; seeing mid-assembly flush (precommit=true) which matches the partials.
ops-elena: adding metric stream.fade.missing_chunk + route tag; alert if >5 in 5m. ETA 2026-04-04.
jun: I'll own client resume protocol change (resume_offset in WS handshake, dedupe by offset). PR target 2026-04-07.
marc: I'll add server flush_coalesce = 150ms and X-Stream-Trace header for mapping. PR target 2026-04-06.
katy: I'll add a replay test that injects delayed flush + concurrent reconnects; schedule first CI run 2026-04-08.
alia: plan: merge minimal-risk changes first, then 48h canary in eu-west-1. I'll coordinate the canary window and rollback plan. Sync Fri 09:00 #incidents.
sre-bot: incident created INC-2026-04-03-streamfade; assigned -> jun, marc.
alia: please paste PR links here as they open. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
